children: U.S. convenience store operator's Q3 net income rose yr/yr, adjusted EBITDA up nearly 9%
Company saw growth in same-store inside merchandise sales and fuel gallons sold
Yesway reaffirmed its full yr 2026 outlook, citing continued business momentum
Yesway reaffirms 2026 Adjusted EBITDA outlook of $235 mln to $245 mln
Company expects 2026 same-store inside merchandise sales growth of 1.25% to 3.25%
Yesway sees 2026 capital expenditures of $85 mln to $95 mln and 6-8 new store openings
FUEL MARGINS - Co said increased fuel margin cents per gallon and higher fuel volumes drove fuel gross profit growth
NEW STORES AND PRICING - Growth in inside merchandise sales attributed to new store openings and pricing actions
HIGHER OPERATING EXPENSES - Operating expenses rose due to higher interchange fees related to increased revenue
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Yesway Inc is $30.00, about 17% above its November 11 closing price of $25.65
